products.name: Together AI
products.note: Decentralized cloud for open models; inference API; model hub; data residency options

profile_text.body:
Together AI describes itself as an "AI Native Cloud" offering a full-stack platform for inference, fine-tuning, and GPU clusters, powered by what it characterizes as cutting-edge research. The platform supports serverless and private model deployments, scaling to 30 billion tokens per model, and includes purpose-built GPU infrastructure for generative media workloads covering video, audio, and image models. The company also offers managed object storage and parallel filesystems optimized for AI workloads, with zero egress fees.

The company's tracked product is its core Together AI platform, described as a decentralized cloud for open models with an inference API, model hub, and data residency options. Together AI has raised $800 million, which it says is intended to accelerate the shift to open-source AI, citing its view that the economics of closed models do not scale. Research contributors affiliated with the company include Tri Dao, who is listed alongside Princeton University and Together AI across multiple published works.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings are recorded in the held facts for Together AI.
